list: the official 55 trophies, verified against the released game 2026-11-20

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. The last one to land is usually A Long Road (100% completion) — once it pops, the platinum follows immediately. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, all single-player, no online trophies and no DLC required.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play — you cannot miss it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 1 of the campaign. It pops automatically when Chapter 2 starts (first mission: What's in the Bag?).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 2 of the campaign. It pops automatically when Chapter 3 starts (first mission: Welcome to Vice City).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 3 of the campaign. It pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 — Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 of the campaign. It pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the final mission and finish the campaign. Automatic. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida, so nothing after this point is locked off.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist (a Chapter 3 mission). Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown (a Chapter 4 mission). Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. Automatic as you play through the story.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story (work done earlier still counts). The thresholds are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 Optional Missions, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app, study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars. The only tasks that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. Both PowerPyx and the guides rank it the hardest trophy in the set.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game — 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps; you can mix categories. 300 count toward 100%. Under the Bridges are the quickest. Track your count under Progress > Activities > Stunts (press R3 on a stunt category to view progress by region), or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of each of the 9 activity types the trophy tracker counts — Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), Playing a Video Game, winning a Car Race / Race Challenge / Top Fun Drone Race, and Performing a Stunt. Any single session of each type counts; you do not need to win or finish them all. View them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 Shooting Range locations. Each challenge has its own gold score — retry them freely, nothing here is missable or timed against the story. For 100% you need every one of them.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in all, one win per location is enough, so move on as soon as each race pops. For 100% you need every drone race, not just one per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once, any race type. There are 40 unique race locations on the map; work through the race markers after the story.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After Chapter 1 — Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and out-fish him — the fishing challenges are the same activity you use to practise, so go in once you know the timing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable at the TV in your home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy, Lucia only. Andy's questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. Complete her 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). All quests are still available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Kenton's questline gets marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) he calls you, then he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He offers sets of treasure-diving quests at shipwrecks — find the underwater treasures with the metal detector and bring them back. In total he wants you to clear 7 shipwrecks. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2-3 (playing as Jason, call Brian to speed it up), so he is not missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Billy's questline gets marked automatically after Chapter 2 — Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his 5 quests — Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job), Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job). All quests are still available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the ? encounters on the map. Only certain questlines count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Confirmed to count are Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy? / Check on Kyle), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper / Mentor Yago, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother / Back Up Yago) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries). Track your count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list. All strands are still there after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy. Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, gets marked automatically after Chapter 3 — Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) — during that mission you unlock the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso to him. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered. Track them under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars in fixed locations and others you can steal off the street. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) — good condition pays more. Cars turn up often in east Vice City at Vice Beach / Ocean Beach. Still doable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy, Jason only. Tyrone's questline gets marked automatically after Chapter 3 — Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them (quest Take Out Kitty Litter). After destroying enough labs Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which unlocks the trophy. All of it is still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts twice. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE TO WATCH: the first meditation is Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth — talk to Lucia in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not confirmed whether it is required, so do it while you can. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the missable one does not matter there. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus — keep a manual save at the start of every chapter (15 manual slots plus one autosave).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy, Jason only. Bret Vogel's questline gets marked after Chapter 2 — Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. His questline is about hunting the animals he requests and bringing them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker). There are 15 Target Decks in all and you need every one for 100%, so this should come naturally. Note: it is still undergoing confirmation which animal exactly pops this trophy.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets hidden around Leonida; you need 15 full sets for 100%, so this pops on the way to A Long Road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source_name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — scan objects in the environment by holding Up then R1. There are more than 100 in all, so it does not matter which you scan: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures (plus No Flusher Tags). Each new location counts once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the open-world feats tracked under Progress > Challenges. There are 80 challenges in all; 70 of 80 count toward 100%, so keep going past 50. Many complete naturally while working on other trophies, so leave this for one of your last trophies and then pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose the heat — break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it cools. The earliest you can do this is after Chapter 2 — Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Easiest escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. It also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission That's Where The Money Is…, since those robberies always trigger 4-star heat.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — keep the heat on through all three robberies. Only possible after Chapter 2 — Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters; call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) while being chased and maintain the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level). Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing. If it does not pop after the 3rd shop, hit a 4th and keep going. Plan a route of three nearby shops before you start.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride 100 different vehicle models; the game logs each new one as discovered. Check Progress to see how many you have, and try anything you have not driven yet. Scanning vehicles with the WAiNK app also helps toward the 200 of 277 base models needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a fight where enemies are clustered together and drop five before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it does not work with the planes out on the airfield; the plane must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight to it; stairs next to the boarding bridge lead directly into the plane. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The trophy is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it pops.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. You find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Enter a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 — Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks Jewelry Store Robberies (marked with a green icon in unfogged map areas). Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm. In the backroom, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy unlocks shortly after leaving the store. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 4 — Optional Mission: That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe). It gets marked automatically from story progress and is the introduction to bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase with cash in and opens the vault, then go in while it is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself — bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips about security vans (purple icon on the map; do his earlier quests first — robbing 2 Payday Loans). Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level; use a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in all — any 5 pop the trophy, all 8 are needed for 100%.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in Chapter 4 — Optional Mission: That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies — robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius (the trophy only pops after you leave the heat zone). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. Fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible — a plane is the fastest way to do it. Mop up whatever fog is left after the story.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang. There are 39 Illegal Gang Operations in all; for 100% you need every one, so this pops automatically along the way. Operations get marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress > Gangs — scroll over a gang to see how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED after launch: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar to unlock the trophy.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: CONFIRMED after launch: steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it through the showroom's window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 — Main Mission: Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The trophy unlock is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away on the street. It only unlocks from this blue Banshee specifically, not from any other car — it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the Gang Operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going, buy Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during Chapter 2 — Optional Mission: Hit Kingpin Bowling, which gets marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it up with Sticky Bombs). The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. Not missable: if you do not rob all 3 items during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the remaining valuables.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your Strength level via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (select character) > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after Chapter 2 — Main Mission: Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase Strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map > Activities, dumbbell icon; there are lots all over Vice City) or work out at home after the story. Always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — every choice that shifts your profile counts, so it builds up across normal play. You can see how many of 500 you have done by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the UI settings (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that affects your reputation you see a little demon face on the right side of the screen. The profiles run Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable. One warning: do not push toward the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent — cops become more aggressive. If you are still short when everything else is done, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Still no confirmed method — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one; it may pop during normal play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: CONFIRMED after launch: complete the UFO Easter Egg. On the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, come solo — the spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed. At the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help — she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Still no confirmed method — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking people while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by from a bike). Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one; the description is the guide.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3 — Main Mission: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer to launder marked bills. Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You need to deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills; it counts across all robberies, you do not need to bring $250,000 at once. This comes naturally while doing all robberies for 100% — bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything; it adds up across every shop in Leonida, so it pops naturally if you buy gear as you go. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive items (14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores and more).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available for purchase after Chapter 2 — Main Mission: Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — you get a notification that a new app has been installed on your phone, Vice City Real Estate, and you buy the garages through the phone app. Save up and sweep them in one pass after the story; robberies are the quickest money, especially in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after Chapter 2 — Main Mission: Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). To register 10 vehicles you must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. Moses is unlocked from the same mission that unlocks the app. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so go for cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
